rows.en: Everyone, take a look! We've got information on the ball bombs.
Ball bombs?

That's right…

This is an outline of the mass-murder weapon, the ball bomb.

I see…

When this big round container explodes, the small ball bombs packed inside scatter in all directions, explode again, and kill huge numbers of people… That's the idea.
Mass murder, that's frightenin'…
But what's this big round container?
Something big enough to hold this many ball bombs…
A gas tank…!

I see, a gas tank…

All right… Guard the industrial zones where gas tanks are located, starting with central Tokyo.

Understood…

Black Cross Army, I won't forgive you! We'll stop this, no matter what!

Come to think of it… this area is where that mist appeared and caused all the commotion, isn't it?

Hmm… The mist seems to have cleared, but something bothers me. All right… Shall I look into it more closely?
How 'bout that?
Who are ye? Some kinda ball monster?
That's rude, ain't it? I'm the Black Cross Army's home run king, Baseball Mask, number 1!
Baseball Mask?
I see… So you're the one behind the mass-murder weapon, the ball bomb?

You catch on quick!

This gas tank holds 400,000 ball bombs! All of Tokyo will be blown sky-high!
Baseball Mask! We won't let you! Go!!
The five of us together…
Gorenger!
If you've got five, we've got nine! The Black Cross Army's dynamite batting lineup! Let's go!!
…and so, he is currently under the Science Patrol's protection.
Is that wise, Muramatsu…
Is it certain that he's an alien with a more advanced civilization than ours?

It has always been the case that more advanced races range farther…

We still know nothing beyond our own galaxy, but he came from another galaxy! Naturally, he must possess correspondingly advanced science.

Besides… I saw his spaceship. Regrettably, it was something we humans today could never hope to build…

Hmm…

If Dr. Namikawa, an authority on space rocket development, goes that far, it must be so.

Dr. Namikawa will henceforth be working as a member of the TDF science group.

Consult him on anything regarding this Alien Zarab's technological capabilities.
In any case, Muramatsu! I'll leave this matter entirely to you. See that the Science Patrol handles it properly.
Cap, it's terrible! Giant Robo has started attacking!
What!? What about Daisaku? What is Unicorn doing?
Daisaku, Arashi and Ide have already rushed to the scene!
Right… Hayata, sortie in the Jet VTOL!
Yes, sir!
Fuji… request Chief Kitakura's cooperation!
Yes, sir!

Just as I thought… This robot is Calamity, the one from the Republic of Merca that the branch chief said BF stole…

All right… I'll beat it with the real Giant Robo!
Whoa!? What are you doing, Arashi?
Ugh… why… would you… do this… ugh…

Fufufu… Who'd have thought it would go this well?

Mister Gold… The operation is a success! We've captured Daisaku Kusama!

Good, wait at Warehouse No. 8 until your pickup arrives!

Giant Robo won't move on anyone's orders but that brat's! Take him back to the branch office, put him under the hypnosis ray, and make him one of us in BF.

Professor Hustler will handle the rest! Hahaha…
That's strange… There's no sign of Arashi or Ide… Could it be…!?
Hayata… Curiosity will be the death of you, you know?

Alien Zarab!? Why are you in the Jet VTOL? How on earth…?

I see… You hypnotized Arashi and Ide, didn't you?
It seems you know far too much.
You intend to rule this Earth, don't you?

Exactly… I was born to do so. Doing so is my job!

However, this Earth has the Science Patrol and Ultraman. Unless I get rid of those two, I can't rule the Earth as I please.

I won't let you!

Cap, Cap!
Hahaha… The radio won't work.
Damn!
You are mine, Ultraman…
What!?
Time for you to sleep, Ultraman. I have no more use for you! The Earth is mine.

…!?

What's that!?
Cap! Hayata's VTOL has crashed!

What!?

Fuji, ask Chief Kitakura to go to the rescue immediately!
Understood…
Security Team, arriving now!

Kitakura!

It seems Hayata's VTOL crashed somewhere around there… Please rescue him right away.
Roger! We'll search and rescue immediately!

Yes, this is HQ…

What!? Ultraman has appeared? He's destroying the city? That's ridiculous!?
Captain Muramatsu… It's definitely Ultraman! What should we do?
Even if it's Ultraman, we have to fight anyone who commits violence on this Earth!
Roger! Commence attack!!

Saburo… They say Calamity's performance is equal to Giant Robo's!

Ultraman is acting strangely too. Until One-Seven gets here, don't push yourself! Be very careful, all right?
I'll be fine! Chief Kitakura is with me. Leave it to us.

Ah!?

That's the Roller Robot! And the Hurricane Robot too…
That's far enough! I've been waiting for you, Saburo Minami!
Damn… Was it a trap!?
It's a joint operation to capture you: BF's attack with Calamity, and Captain Gomez's!
A joint operation?

That's right…

With Brain's super-production capability, mass-producing Brain robots is easy!

Behold! The power of Calamity and Ultraman…
Ultraman?
Fufufu… Right, take Saburo Minami away!
Damn, let go!! What are you going to do with me?
Fufufu… We'll use you to lure out One-Seven.
Hehehe… Looks like it went well on your end too?
Ah, Saburo!
Daisaku, and Arashi and Ide too? How on earth…?

uncertain: U04983: Kaijo musing aloud; 'Shall I look into it' kept as self-address.
U04986/U04993: Baseball Mask's baseball wordplay kept (number 1, dynamite batting lineup).
U05043: [ja] rendered as a joint operation of BF and Gomez.
U05045: Kid says 'Calamity and Ultraman', meaning the fake Ultraman.
